<infobox theme="astro">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="region"><label>Region(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="sector"><label>Sector</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|self||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|none||{{{sector|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Grid square</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates}}}}}|n/a||{{{coordinates|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="xyz"><label>XYZ coordinates</label></data>	
        <data source="distance"><label>Distance from Core</label></data>	
        <data source="system"><label>System(s)</label></data>
        <data source="suns"><label>Suns</label></data>
        <data source="planets"><label>Planets</label></data>		
        <data source="stations"><label>Space stations</label></data>
        <data source="asteroids"><label>Asteroids</label></data>
        <data source="comets"><label>Comets</label></data>	
        <data source="routes"><label>Trade routes</label></data>
        <data source="other"><label>Other objects</label></data>
        <data source="formed"><label>Formed from</label></data>
        <data source="size"><label>Size</label></data>
        <data source="distinctions"><label>Distinctions</label></data>		
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Societal information</header>
        <data source="species"><label>Native species</label></data>	
        <data source="otherspecies"><label>Other species</label></data>	
        <data source="language"><label>Primary language(s)</label></data>
        <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
        <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>
        <data source="interest"><label>Points of interest</label></data>
        <data source="imports"><label>Major imports</label></data>
        <data source="exports"><label>Major exports</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>	
	</group>
    <group layout="stacked">
    	<header>Battles in or near the {{{name|}}}</header>
        <data source="b1"><label>{{{battles1}}}</label></data>
        <data source="b2"><label>{{{battles2}}}</label></data>
        <data source="b3"><label>{{{battles3}}}</label></data>
        <data source="b4"><label>{{{battles4}}}</label></data>
        <data source="b5"><label>{{{battles5}}}</label></data>
        <data source="b6"><label>{{{battles6}}}</label></data>
    </group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Nebula|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.

-->{{#if:{{NAMESPACE}}||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only|[[Category:Legends locations with canon-only grid coordinates]]|{{#invoke:PlanetGridCheck|main|outside=1|unlisted={{{unlisted|}}}|region={{{region|}}}|sector={{{sector|}}}|system=N/A}}}}}}<noinclude>[[category:Astrographical infobox templates]]{{clear}}
